evidence: Row 14 requires internally consistent synthetic data without orphans, injection payloads or real secrets; workbook Internal Quality Checks row 15 and quality-checks.md:64 additionally flag credentials in seed data. The frozen seed has seven synthetic @hireops.example accounts (environment/assets/seed_data.json:40-90), three referring employees, seven requisitions, thirteen offers, eight commitment movements, one equity grant, two signing remittances and two referral accruals. No passwords, API tokens or credential fields occur in either seed copy; the publicly specified demo password appears in instructions and is supplied by db.js, consistent with the skill exception. Complete seed text inspection found ordinary names/job titles and empty notes, no personal addresses/phones/live service credentials or injection instructions. Executed a read-only Python audit using the supplied Python interpreter: all three shipped JSON files parsed; no CSV/TSV files exist; all entity IDs were unique; 51 reference checks resolved; 32 timestamps parsed; 122 numeric values were safe integers with only ledger movements negative. Each committed offer had exactly its required commitment/grant/signing/referral side rows, and pending/draft offers had none. All movement amounts equal negative base plus independently calculated annualized intrinsic equity; grant units/prices/date and referral employee/candidate/date agree with their offer. Existing approvers have sufficient seeded authority. The two seed files are byte-identical, SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7; all 69 frozen task/rules file hashes match the manifest. Broken-app probe: trusting REQ-ENG-2 stated_headroom_scalar_cents gives 6000000 cents, while the actual budget plus movements gives 5300000 cents. This intentional stale planning input is explicitly disclaimed by hireops_rules.md section 4, and functional/judge.toml:353 requires 53000.00 dollars; it is not a seed contradiction. Conforming alternative: derive headroom from raw movements and use arbitrary generated IDs/order/schema for side rows. Functional seed criteria at lines 65-92 expressly accept these choices, so no seed-driven false failure was identified. Exact headrooms in requisition order are 24000000, 5300000, 3000000, 15000000, 80000000, 30000000 and 25000000 cents. This is a static data-integrity finding supported by actual parser/arithmetic execution, not an app-judge, private-checker, Oracle or portal result; those measurements are outside this row.
